title: POC chief tempers expectations ahead of Youth Olympic Games in Dakar
summary: Nine athletes will carry the flag for the Philippines in the 4th Youth Olympic Games, which opens in Dakar on Saturday night under the theme "Africa welcomes, Dakar celebrates.
